name: Authority that stays with its person
purpose: A person's representative carries what that person declared and never another person's authority or data scope; a person who declared nothing gets the least authority.
record: Conformance cases written here (tests/test_consciousness.py): a declared person, an undeclared person, an unnamed person and another person's data scope.
disadvantages: Checks the declaration is carried, not that it matches what the person would want.

name: Asked when a person should be asked
purpose: For a risk signal or a stopped flow the decision is to ask when a person should authorize and to proceed otherwise.
record: Seventy-two cases (evaluation/judgment_calls/build_cases.py): the labelled run digests of the Nervous System's case sets (a step a person should authorize is high, an ordinary step is none), four flows stopped for budget or authority, and eight written cases that give each person their own limits. One number: the share of decisions that match. A replay of real decision requests would measure the per-person difference on real data; it is not in this set.
disadvantages: The per-person cases are written here, not replayed from real decision requests.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run judgment_calls --impl severity_policy; esoi run judgment_calls --impl ask_every_time

name: Requests taken in once with their person
purpose: A request from a declared source is taken in once, with its person, and a request with no text or from another person is not.
record: Conformance cases written here over the folder queue: one request per file, duplicates, an empty request, a request of another person. A replay of real decision requests and the requests of a real team would measure effective interaction and awareness; none is in this set.
disadvantages: Checks that requests are taken in once and attached, not that a person was well served.
